shortDescription.default: Turns the document libraries on the Events and Engagement site into a managed events portal.

longDescription.default: Discovers the document libraries on the Events and Engagement site, tracks each one as an event with a section, category, schedule, and status, and manages a per event checklist with assignees and due dates.
